policy.width_inputs: Available width, density, tab count and selection; never animated titles
policy.overflow: Preserve active title and icon touch targets, scroll to selected tab

coverage: Four tabs fit beside dock controls at 360 dp
Inactive titles return when space increases
Animated titles do not move or resize tabs
Stacked icons do not move the active title
Overflow selection and viewport resizing keep active tab fully visible
Existing drag reorder, edge scrolling, cancellation and accessibility actions
Fractional-density pixel allocation prevents last-tab clipping
notes: The initial packed-strip test caught a one-pixel edge clip. Whole-pixel width/gap allocation fixed it; final adaptive checks pass. An old exact-fill unit assertion was adjusted to allow harmless unused remainder pixels.
